verdict.rationale: Kintsugi's own Get Filings API returns filing records filtered by jurisdiction and status, and filings by registration ID. Its refund handling claims filings reflect what was actually kept, which gives some per-jurisdiction filing detail. Nothing documents a live accrued-liability view, a collected-versus-owed reconciliation, or exports built for accountants or a GL; the accounting connectors are documented as inbound transaction sync. Missing for 10: real-time accrued liability by jurisdiction, collected vs owed comparison, accountant/GL export formats or outbound GL sync, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can see accrued liability by jurisdiction at any moment — collected versus owed, filing-ready detail, and exports my accountant and GL can consume

citations.quote: The Get Filings API retrieves a paginated list of filings based on filters such as dates, jurisdiction, Country, status, etc.
This allows users to query detailed filing information tied to a specific registration record.
The outcome is filings that reflect what you actually kept.
